-- class: expand
-- kind: add-column
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."tasks" add column "token" uuid;

-- class: expand
-- kind: set-default
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."tasks" alter column "token" set default gen_random_uuid();

-- class: expand
-- kind: backfill-expand
-- action: backfill
-- lock: ROW EXCLUSIVE
-- backfill table="public"."tasks" key="id" batch=1000
-- transactional: false
update "public"."tasks" set "token" = gen_random_uuid() where "token" is null and ($1::text is null or "id" > $1::bigint) and ($2::text is null or "id" <= $2::bigint);

-- class: expand
-- kind: add-constraint
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."tasks" add constraint "tasks_token_notnull" check ("token" is not null) not valid;

-- class: expand
-- kind: validate-constraint
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."tasks" validate constraint "tasks_token_notnull";

-- class: expand
-- kind: add-column
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."tasks" alter column "token" set not null;

-- class: expand
-- kind: drop-not-null-check
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."tasks" drop constraint "tasks_token_notnull";

-- class: expand
-- kind: add-constraint
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."tasks" add constraint "tasks_token_check" check ((token IN ('a'))) not valid;

-- class: expand
-- kind: validate-constraint
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."tasks" validate constraint "tasks_token_check";
